worldcombat.skill.quickguard.summary: Raises a fast brace a beat before the foe's next strike, letting the user and nearby allies each catch the first direct enemy hit, shaving it by a bounded sixty percent before that person's brace shatters. It holds only a moment; non-direct hits pass through.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.use.0: Catch the first direct melee or projectile hit
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.use.1: Raise the brace a beat before a foe's dash opens
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.use.2: Eat one quick hit each for the team in the shortest window
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.description: Each covered person shaves sixty percent off the first direct enemy hit, up to about %1$s damage; the brace stands for about %2$s and falls when it catches a hit or its time is up.
When raised it covers the user and allies within %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.brace.snap: Snap: absorption cap x0.75, radius x0.85, in exchange for -1 tick wind-up and x0.85 cooldown — the fastest raise.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.brace.stead: Steady: absorption cap x1.25, radius x1.05, at +1 tick wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — a larger, steadier brace.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
Snap: absorption cap x0.75, radius x0.85, -1 tick wind-up, x0.85 cooldown — quickest to raise, good for catching a dash as it opens. Steady: absorption cap x1.25, radius x1.05, +1 tick wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — a larger, steadier brace, good for catching a hit for each ally.
Consider the brace once a threat is within this distance; an observed priority strike or a closing projectile/melee raises it further. Larger predicts earlier but wastes more braces.
When on, the brace is only raised while another ally is inside the alert radius; when off, pressure on the user is enough.
worldcombat.skill.quickguard.description: The brace only catches enemy direct hits (native melee, projectiles and real damaging moves), and only the first one per person: it shaves sixty percent, never more than that person's absorption cap, so any excess on that hit still lands. Residual, environmental and self-cost damage do not spend the brace. Allies' moves and your own moves are unaffected. A covered ally that moves too far from the user, or loses line of sight to the user, loses the protection early.
